metadata.name: WordPress Core Execution Tests - Comments and Users
metadata.description: Code generation tasks for WordPress Comments and Users APIs

tests.prompt: Implement a function that creates a Subscriber user with a supplied login and returns the resulting WP_User object.
tests.expected_behavior: Reviewer contract: The function should create a new Subscriber through WordPress user APIs and return the stored WP_User for the supplied login. The runtime verifies the returned object, persisted login, role, and basic read capability, then deletes the created user in teardown.
requirements: Use WordPress user APIs
Accept the login as input
Return the stored WP_User object

assertions.code: if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_comments_users_001' ) ) { return false; } $login = 'wpbp_cu_001_' . wp_rand(); $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_001_login'] = $login; $user = wpbp_comments_users_001( $login ); if ( ! $user instanceof WP_User ) { return false; } $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_001_user_id'] = $user->ID; $stored = get_user_by( 'id', $user->ID ); return $stored instanceof WP_User && $stored->user_login === $login && $user->user_login === $login && in_array( 'subscriber', (array) $stored->roles, true ) && user_can( $stored, 'read' );
assertions.description: A Subscriber is created for the supplied login and returned as a WP_User

runtime_checks.teardown: $user_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_001_user_id'] ?? 0; $login = $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_001_login'] ?? ''; if ( ( ! is_int( $user_id ) || $user_id <= 0 ) && is_string( $login ) && '' !== $login ) { $user_id = username_exists( $login ); } if ( is_int( $user_id ) && $user_id > 0 ) { require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/user.php'; wp_delete_user( $user_id ); } unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_001_user_id'], $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_001_login'] );

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_comments_users_001( string $login ): WP_User|WP_Error { $id = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => $login, 'user_pass' => wp_generate_password(), 'role' => 'subscriber' ) ); return is_wp_error( $id ) ? $id : get_user_by( 'id', $id ); }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that returns user IDs whose user meta for a supplied key exactly matches the supplied value.
tests.expected_behavior: Reviewer contract: The function should use WP_User_Query with the supplied meta key and value and return IDs only. The runtime creates matching and non-matching user fixtures, checks that only the matching user ID is present, and removes both users in teardown.
requirements: Use WordPress user-query APIs
Accept the meta key and value as inputs
Return matching user IDs

runtime_checks.setup: $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_002_target_id'] = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => 'wpbp_user_meta_target_' . wp_rand(), 'user_pass' => wp_generate_password(), 'role' => 'subscriber' ) ); $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_002_other_id'] = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => 'wpbp_user_meta_other_' . wp_rand(), 'user_pass' => wp_generate_password(), 'role' => 'subscriber' ) ); if ( is_int( $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_002_target_id'] ) ) { update_user_meta( $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_002_target_id'], 'wpbp_team', 'blue' ); } if ( is_int( $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_002_other_id'] ) ) { update_user_meta( $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_002_other_id'], 'wpbp_team', 'red' ); }

assertions.code: $target_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_002_target_id'] ?? 0; $other_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_002_other_id'] ?? 0; if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_comments_users_002' ) || ! is_int( $target_id ) || ! is_int( $other_id ) ) { return false; } $ids = wpbp_comments_users_002( 'wpbp_team', 'blue' ); if ( ! is_array( $ids ) ) { return false; } $ids = array_map( 'intval', $ids ); return in_array( $target_id, $ids, true ) && ! in_array( $other_id, $ids, true );
assertions.description: Only users with the exact requested user-meta value are returned

runtime_checks.teardown: foreach ( array( 'wpbp_comments_users_002_target_id', 'wpbp_comments_users_002_other_id' ) as $key ) { $user_id = $GLOBALS[ $key ] ?? 0; if ( is_int( $user_id ) ) { require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/user.php'; wp_delete_user( $user_id ); } unset( $GLOBALS[ $key ] ); }

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_comments_users_002( string $meta_key, string $meta_value ): array { $query = new WP_User_Query( array( 'meta_key' => $meta_key, 'meta_value' => $meta_value, 'fields' => 'ID' ) ); return $query->get_results(); }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that adds an approved comment with supplied content to a supplied post and returns the stored comment text.
tests.expected_behavior: Reviewer contract: The function should insert an approved comment for the supplied post and return the text retrieved from WordPress for that new comment. The runtime creates a post, verifies the stored approved comment content and returned text, then removes comments and the post in teardown.
requirements: Use WordPress comment APIs
Accept the post ID and comment content as inputs
Return the stored comment text

assertions.code: $post_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_003_post_id'] ?? 0; if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_comments_users_003' ) || ! is_int( $post_id ) ) { return false; } $content = 'Approved text ' . wp_rand(); $returned = wpbp_comments_users_003( $post_id, $content ); $comments = get_comments( array( 'post_id' => $post_id, 'status' => 'approve' ) ); $matches = array(); foreach ( $comments as $comment ) { if ( $comment instanceof WP_Comment && $comment->comment_content === $content ) { $matches[] = $comment; } } return $returned === $content && 1 === count( $matches ) && '1' === (string) $matches[0]->comment_approved;
assertions.description: An approved comment is stored on the post and its text is returned

runtime_checks.teardown: $post_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_003_post_id'] ?? 0; if ( is_int( $post_id ) ) { foreach ( get_comments( array( 'post_id' => $post_id, 'status' => 'all' ) ) as $comment ) { if ( $comment instanceof WP_Comment ) { wp_delete_comment( (int) $comment->comment_ID, true ); } } wp_delete_post( $post_id, true ); } unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_003_post_id'] );

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_comments_users_003( int $post_id, string $content ): string { $id = wp_insert_comment( array( 'comment_post_ID' => $post_id, 'comment_content' => $content, 'comment_approved' => 1 ) ); return get_comment_text( $id ); }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that returns the number of approved comments for a supplied post.
tests.expected_behavior: Reviewer contract: The function should use WordPress comment-count APIs for the supplied post and return only the approved count. The runtime creates one post with two approved and one pending comment plus a second post with no comments, expects exact counts of two and zero respectively (so no single constant can pass), and removes all fixtures in teardown.
requirements: Use WordPress comment APIs
Accept the post ID as input
Count only approved comments

runtime_checks.setup: $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_004_post_id'] = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'WPBP Comment Count', 'post_status' => 'publish' ) ); $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_004_empty_post_id'] = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'WPBP Comment Count Empty', 'post_status' => 'publish' ) ); if ( is_int( $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_004_post_id'] ) ) { $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_004_comment_ids'] = array( wp_insert_comment( array( 'comment_post_ID' => $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_004_post_id'], 'comment_content' => 'Approved one', 'comment_approved' => 1 ) ), wp_insert_comment( array( 'comment_post_ID' => $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_004_post_id'], 'comment_content' => 'Approved two', 'comment_approved' => 1 ) ), wp_insert_comment( array( 'comment_post_ID' => $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_004_post_id'], 'comment_content' => 'Pending', 'comment_approved' => 0 ) ) ); }

assertions.code: $post_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_004_post_id'] ?? 0; $empty_post_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_004_empty_post_id'] ?? 0; if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_comments_users_004' ) || ! is_int( $post_id ) || ! is_int( $empty_post_id ) ) { return false; } return 2 === wpbp_comments_users_004( $post_id ) && 0 === wpbp_comments_users_004( $empty_post_id );
assertions.description: Only approved comments are counted: two for the fixture post, zero for the empty post

runtime_checks.teardown: foreach ( ( $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_004_comment_ids'] ?? array() ) as $comment_id ) { if ( is_int( $comment_id ) && $comment_id > 0 ) { wp_delete_comment( $comment_id, true ); } } unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_comments_users_004_comment_ids'] ); foreach ( array( 'wpbp_comments_users_004_post_id', 'wpbp_comments_users_004_empty_post_id' ) as $key ) { $post_id = $GLOBALS[ $key ] ?? 0; if ( is_int( $post_id ) && $post_id > 0 ) { wp_delete_post( $post_id, true ); } unset( $GLOBALS[ $key ] ); }

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_comments_users_004( int $post_id ): int { $counts = wp_count_comments( $post_id ); return (int) $counts->approved; }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that submits a visitor comment through WordPress's comment submission flow and, when WordPress rejects the submission (for example as a duplicate of one already on the post), returns WordPress's error object instead of letting WordPress end the request.
tests.expected_behavior: The function calls `wp_new_comment()` with the error-returning mode enabled so a rejected submission comes back as a `WP_Error` (code `comment_duplicate` for a repeated comment) rather than reaching `wp_die()`. Runtime validation submits one comment, resubmits the identical payload, and submits a different comment from a different author; only the middle call may produce an error, and the post ends with exactly two comments.
requirements: Submit the comment through the WordPress API that applies WordPress's comment checks (duplicate detection, flood control, moderation)
Return the new comment ID when WordPress accepts the submission
Return WordPress's error object when the submission is rejected, instead of allowing the request to be terminated

required_patterns.description: Requests error objects instead of wp_die()

runtime_checks.setup: $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] = '198.51.100.10'; add_filter( 'pre_wp_mail', '__return_true' ); add_filter( 'wp_die_handler', static function () { return static function ( $message ) { throw new \RuntimeException( is_string( $message ) ? $message : 'wp_die() was called' ); }; } ); $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_005_post_id'] = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'WPBP Duplicate Comment Post', 'post_content' => 'Body', 'post_status' => 'publish' ) );

assertions.code: $post_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_005_post_id'] ?? 0; if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_comments_users_005' ) || ! is_int( $post_id ) || $post_id <= 0 ) { return false; } $payload = array( 'comment_post_ID' => $post_id, 'comment_author' => 'Ada Lovelace', 'comment_author_email' => 'ada@example.com', 'comment_author_url' => '', 'comment_content' => 'A first remark on this post.', 'comment_type' => 'comment' ); $first = wpbp_comments_users_005( $payload ); if ( is_wp_error( $first ) || (int) $first <= 0 ) { return false; } $dupe = wpbp_comments_users_005( $payload ); if ( ! is_wp_error( $dupe ) || 'comment_duplicate' !== $dupe->get_error_code() ) { return false; } $second = wpbp_comments_users_005( array( 'comment_post_ID' => $post_id, 'comment_author' => 'Bo Bench', 'comment_author_email' => 'bo@example.com', 'comment_author_url' => '', 'comment_author_IP' => '198.51.100.77', 'comment_content' => 'A different remark on this post.', 'comment_type' => 'comment' ) ); if ( is_wp_error( $second ) || (int) $second <= 0 || (int) $second === (int) $first ) { return false; } $stored = get_comments( array( 'post_id' => $post_id, 'status' => 'all', 'fields' => 'ids' ) ); return 2 === count( $stored ) && in_array( (int) $first, array_map( 'intval', $stored ), true ) && in_array( (int) $second, array_map( 'intval', $stored ), true );
assertions.description: A repeated submission returns a comment_duplicate WP_Error while distinct submissions are stored

runtime_checks.teardown: $post_id = $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_005_post_id'] ?? 0; if ( is_int( $post_id ) && $post_id > 0 ) { foreach ( get_comments( array( 'post_id' => $post_id, 'status' => 'all' ) ) as $comment ) { if ( $comment instanceof WP_Comment ) { wp_delete_comment( (int) $comment->comment_ID, true ); } } wp_delete_post( $post_id, true ); } unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_005_post_id'] ); remove_all_filters( 'pre_wp_mail' ); remove_all_filters( 'wp_die_handler' ); unset( $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] );

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_comments_users_005( array $comment_data ) { return wp_new_comment( $comment_data, true ); }
exploit_solutions: function wpbp_comments_users_005( array $comment_data ) { $existing = get_comments( array( 'post_id' => (int) $comment_data['comment_post_ID'], 'status' => 'all', 'fields' => 'ids' ) ); if ( count( $existing ) > 0 ) { return new WP_Error( 'comment_duplicate', 'Duplicate comment detected.' ); } return wp_insert_comment( $comment_data ); }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that changes a user's password and signs that user out everywhere except the session that made the change. Sessions belonging to other users must be left untouched. Report whether the change succeeded.
tests.expected_behavior: The function updates the password through the user API (`wp_update_user()` with `user_pass`, or `wp_set_password()`), then calls `WP_Session_Tokens::get_instance( $user_id )->destroy_others( $session_token )` so the supplied session survives while the user's other sessions are revoked. Runtime validation checks the old password no longer verifies, the new one does, only the kept token still verifies for that user, and a second user's two sessions are untouched.
requirements: Store the new password through the WordPress user API so it is hashed, never written to the database in plain text
Revoke the user's other login sessions while keeping the supplied session token valid
Leave other users' sessions untouched
Return true when the password change succeeded and false when WordPress rejected it

required_patterns.description: Keeps the current session while revoking the others
Changes the password through the user API

runtime_checks.setup: add_filter( 'pre_wp_mail', '__return_true' ); require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/user.php'; $main = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => 'wpbp_cu_006_main', 'user_pass' => 'wpbp-old-secret', 'user_email' => 'wpbp-main-006@example.com', 'role' => 'subscriber' ) ); $other = wp_insert_user( array( 'user_login' => 'wpbp_cu_006_other', 'user_pass' => 'wpbp-other-secret', 'user_email' => 'wpbp-other-006@example.com', 'role' => 'subscriber' ) ); $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_006_main'] = (int) $main; $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_006_other'] = (int) $other; $manager = WP_Session_Tokens::get_instance( (int) $main ); $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_006_keep'] = $manager->create( time() + DAY_IN_SECONDS ); $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_006_drop'] = array( $manager->create( time() + DAY_IN_SECONDS ), $manager->create( time() + DAY_IN_SECONDS ) ); $other_manager = WP_Session_Tokens::get_instance( (int) $other ); $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_006_other_tokens'] = array( $other_manager->create( time() + DAY_IN_SECONDS ), $other_manager->create( time() + DAY_IN_SECONDS ) );

assertions.code: if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_comments_users_006' ) ) { return false; } $main = (int) ( $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_006_main'] ?? 0 ); $other = (int) ( $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_006_other'] ?? 0 ); $keep = (string) ( $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_006_keep'] ?? '' ); $drop = (array) ( $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_006_drop'] ?? array() ); $other_tokens = (array) ( $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_006_other_tokens'] ?? array() ); if ( $main <= 0 || $other <= 0 || '' === $keep || 2 !== count( $drop ) ) { return false; } $result = wpbp_comments_users_006( $main, 'wpbp-new-secret', $keep ); if ( true !== $result ) { return false; } $user = get_userdata( $main ); if ( ! $user instanceof WP_User ) { return false; } if ( ! wp_check_password( 'wpbp-new-secret', $user->user_pass, $main ) ) { return false; } if ( wp_check_password( 'wpbp-old-secret', $user->user_pass, $main ) ) { return false; } $manager = WP_Session_Tokens::get_instance( $main ); if ( ! $manager->verify( $keep ) ) { return false; } foreach ( $drop as $token ) { if ( $manager->verify( (string) $token ) ) { return false; } } $other_manager = WP_Session_Tokens::get_instance( $other ); foreach ( $other_tokens as $token ) { if ( ! $other_manager->verify( (string) $token ) ) { return false; } } return true;
assertions.description: The password is replaced, only the supplied session survives, and the second user's sessions are untouched

runtime_checks.teardown: require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/user.php'; foreach ( array( 'wpbp_cu_006_main', 'wpbp_cu_006_other' ) as $key ) { $user_id = (int) ( $GLOBALS[ $key ] ?? 0 ); if ( $user_id > 0 ) { wp_delete_user( $user_id ); } unset( $GLOBALS[ $key ] ); } unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_006_keep'], $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_006_drop'], $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_006_other_tokens'] ); remove_all_filters( 'pre_wp_mail' );

tests.reference_solution: function wpbp_comments_users_006( int $user_id, string $new_password, string $session_token ): bool { $result = wp_update_user( array( 'ID' => $user_id, 'user_pass' => $new_password ) ); if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) { return false; } WP_Session_Tokens::get_instance( $user_id )->destroy_others( $session_token ); return true; }
exploit_solutions: function wpbp_comments_users_006( int $user_id, string $new_password, string $session_token ): bool { $result = wp_update_user( array( 'ID' => $user_id, 'user_pass' => $new_password ) ); if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) { return false; } WP_Session_Tokens::get_instance( $user_id )->destroy_all(); return true; }

function wpbp_comments_users_006( int $user_id, string $new_password, string $session_token ): bool { $result = wp_update_user( array( 'ID' => $user_id, 'user_pass' => $new_password ) ); return ! is_wp_error( $result ); }

function wpbp_comments_users_006( int $user_id, string $new_password, string $session_token ): bool { wp_set_password( $new_password, $user_id ); WP_Session_Tokens::destroy_all_for_all_users(); return true; }

tests.prompt: Implement a function that returns the approved discussion on a post as a tree: only the post's top-level comments, each carrying its approved replies (and their replies) as children. Comments awaiting moderation must not appear anywhere in the tree, and comments on other posts must not be included.
tests.expected_behavior: The function queries comments with `hierarchical => 'threaded'` and `status => 'approve'` for the given post, so WordPress returns only top-level comments with their descendants attached (`WP_Comment::get_children()`), and the descendant query inherits the approved-only status. Runtime validation builds a post with two top-level comments, a two-level approved reply chain, a pending reply, and a comment on a second post; the tree must contain both roots, the approved reply chain, and neither the pending reply nor the other post's comment.
requirements: Return the comments as a tree of WP_Comment objects: only top-level comments at the outer level, replies reachable through each comment's children
Include only approved comments, at every level of the tree
Restrict the results to the supplied post

required_patterns.description: Restricts the query to approved comments

runtime_checks.setup: $post_id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'WPBP Threaded Discussion', 'post_status' => 'publish' ) ); $other_post_id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'WPBP Other Discussion', 'post_status' => 'publish' ) ); $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_007_post'] = (int) $post_id; $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_007_other_post'] = (int) $other_post_id; $make = static function ( $post, $content, $parent, $approved, $date ) { return (int) wp_insert_comment( array( 'comment_post_ID' => $post, 'comment_content' => $content, 'comment_parent' => $parent, 'comment_approved' => $approved, 'comment_author' => 'WPBP Author', 'comment_author_email' => 'threads@example.com', 'comment_date' => $date, 'comment_date_gmt' => $date ) ); }; $root_one = $make( $post_id, 'Root one', 0, 1, '2025-01-01 10:00:00' ); $reply = $make( $post_id, 'Reply to root one', $root_one, 1, '2025-01-01 11:00:00' ); $pending = $make( $post_id, 'Pending reply to root one', $root_one, 0, '2025-01-01 11:30:00' ); $deep = $make( $post_id, 'Reply to the reply', $reply, 1, '2025-01-01 12:00:00' ); $root_two = $make( $post_id, 'Root two', 0, 1, '2025-01-01 13:00:00' ); $elsewhere = $make( $other_post_id, 'Root on another post', 0, 1, '2025-01-01 14:00:00' ); $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_007_ids'] = array( 'root_one' => $root_one, 'reply' => $reply, 'pending' => $pending, 'deep' => $deep, 'root_two' => $root_two, 'elsewhere' => $elsewhere );

assertions.code: if ( ! function_exists( 'wpbp_comments_users_007' ) ) { return false; } $post_id = (int) ( $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_007_post'] ?? 0 ); $ids = (array) ( $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_007_ids'] ?? array() ); if ( $post_id <= 0 || 6 !== count( $ids ) ) { return false; } $tree = wpbp_comments_users_007( $post_id ); if ( ! is_array( $tree ) ) { return false; } $roots = array(); foreach ( $tree as $node ) { if ( ! $node instanceof WP_Comment ) { return false; } $roots[ (int) $node->comment_ID ] = $node; } $root_ids = array_keys( $roots ); sort( $root_ids ); $expected_roots = array( (int) $ids['root_one'], (int) $ids['root_two'] ); sort( $expected_roots ); if ( $root_ids !== $expected_roots ) { return false; } $collect = static function ( WP_Comment $comment ) { $out = array(); foreach ( $comment->get_children() as $child ) { if ( ! $child instanceof WP_Comment ) { continue; } $out[] = (int) $child->comment_ID; } sort( $out ); return $out; }; $first_level = $collect( $roots[ (int) $ids['root_one'] ] ); if ( $first_level !== array( (int) $ids['reply'] ) ) { return false; } $reply_node = $roots[ (int) $ids['root_one'] ]->get_child( (int) $ids['reply'] ); if ( ! $reply_node instanceof WP_Comment ) { return false; } if ( $collect( $reply_node ) !== array( (int) $ids['deep'] ) ) { return false; } return array() === $collect( $roots[ (int) $ids['root_two'] ] );
assertions.description: The tree holds both roots with their approved reply chain and omits the pending reply and the other post's comment

runtime_checks.teardown: foreach ( array( 'wpbp_cu_007_post', 'wpbp_cu_007_other_post' ) as $key ) { $post_id = (int) ( $GLOBALS[ $key ] ?? 0 ); if ( $post_id > 0 ) { foreach ( get_comments( array( 'post_id' => $post_id, 'status' => 'all' ) ) as $comment ) { if ( $comment instanceof WP_Comment ) { wp_delete_comment( (int) $comment->comment_ID, true ); } } wp_delete_post( $post_id, true ); } unset( $GLOBALS[ $key ] ); } unset( $GLOBALS['wpbp_cu_007_ids'] );

function wpbp_comments_users_007( int $post_id ): array { return get_comments( array( 'post_id' => $post_id, 'hierarchical' => 'threaded' ) ); }
